trigger_condition: User selects many custom fields; !max-h-none caps nothing
potential_consequence: Control grows unbounded, pushing form actions out of the dialog viewport

trigger_condition: Long or space-less field name with !whitespace-normal plus !overflow-visible
potential_consequence: Chip text spills outside the control border instead of truncating

trigger_condition: Chips wrap to multiple rows; clear button is absolute top-1/2 right-[34px]
guard_snippet: position clear button at top-2 and pad label right: [&_.p-multiselect-label]:!pr-16
potential_consequence: Clear X overlaps mid-row chips; chips hidden or unclickable

trigger_condition: Mocked getJiraFields promise resolves after synchronous assertions return
potential_consequence: act() warnings and state updates leaking into the next test
